Tasks (default): opens with a Before-photo card (caption "Take a photo of the job Before proceeding", up to 6 photos saved as <job#>BEF-1..6.jpg, each with a note stored inside the JPEG), followed by a Tasks card (heading row: Tasks, Add Task button in the middle, Save to price sheet toggle at right; Type defaults to Labor; per-line Remove); line items with inline edit (Cancel/Remove), manual add, Build lines from tasks, auto-picked service area shown read-only, and Payment Outlay including applied contingencies. screens.purpose: Lets owners/admins build, price, share and print a job's estimate from line items, manually or from the price sheet.
screens.missing: Stage is inferred (estimate precedes scheduling); no direct nav except onBack; approveEstimate is imported, but its button was not checked.

screens.title: Schedule
screens.summary: Schedule #0058 (after Calendar Redux): opens from the job header's schedule label or from Job menu > Schedule. An inline month calendar (Sun-Sat grid, previous/next month arrows) with hour, minute and AM/PM columns, like the browser's date-time popup. A bold heading above it shows the saved date and time (e.g. "Thursday, October 22, 2026 at 12:39 PM to 1:39 PM") or "Not scheduled". Save, Clear and Cancel sit at the top: Save is enabled only after a change, Clear empties the pending date/time, Cancel discards the pending change and shows the saved date/time again. Changing a saved date/time and pressing Save asks "Reschedule?" (Yes / No): Yes saves and adds a "Rescheduled" entry to the job's trail, No restores the saved date/time. Clearing a saved date/time and pressing Save asks "Remove from schedule?" (Yes / No). The calendar marks every scheduled job (dots) and every blackout (red day number and a red dot). Tapping a day makes it the pending date and lists that day's jobs and blackouts underneath; tapping a listed job or blackout opens a popup. A job shows name, address, phone and job description plus an "Open job" link (hidden for the job you are already on) that switches to that job; a blackout shows its time-off details; "Close" dismisses the popup. The job's Options menu has a "Blackout Dates?" toggle that shows or hides the red blackouts (on by default each time a job is opened). No longer on this screen: Prem Tech / Service Tech / Service Area at the top, the Technicians / Blackouts / Request time off bar (the Calendar tab keeps it), the From/To time popup, and "Cancel visit".
screens.purpose: Lets an admin schedule a job by picking a date and time on an inline calendar, see every other scheduled job and blackout around it, then save, reschedule or clear the job's schedule.
